component.name: App Switcher
component.summary: Window switcher with live thumbnail previews for COSMIC

description.p: A resident COSMIC window switcher with live thumbnail previews. Press Super+Tab or Alt+Tab to cycle through a balanced grid of up to three rows of open windows. The selected window's icon and title appear directly under its preview, and the page counter shows your position when the list paginates.
The panel applet lets you choose Dark, Light, Frosted, or Midnight themes, limit the switcher to the current monitor, and enable or disable the Super+Tab shortcut without using a terminal.
Based on the original cosmic-ext-app-switcher by j0rdiun.
